children: Amplitude Energy served up a very strong operational quarter in 1Q, says its bull at Euroz Hartleys. Quarterly output of 7.51 petajoules equivalent was a record for the company. Revenue of A$83.3 million was up 18% on quarter. "The current production run-rate could support an upgrade to FY27 production guidance" of 26.6 million-28.5 million barrels of oil equivalent, analyst Declan Bonnick says. Another standout was Amplitude's net debt of A$31.1 million at the end of September. That was down A$6.7 million on the June quarter and was achieved despite significant capex, Euroz Hartleyss ays. Amplitude's stock is shaping for a 4.7% rise early Monday to A$1.89. (david.winning@wsj.com; @dwinningWSJ)
